scoring_justification: Checker recomputes average absolute deviations from the agent's raw CSV and hidden experimental values, and checks norbornenone values against paper-reported ranges.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table 5 of the paper, 'Experiment' column, values from [9] corrected to 100% ee.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Transcribed directly from the paper's Table 5 experimental column.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual literature values used in the paper's own evaluation; they are public but hidden to force recomputation.

hidden_assets.purpose: paper-reported average absolute deviations for B3LYP, CCSD, CC2, HF
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Section 3 (Results) and Abstract of the paper; computed from Table 5 values for molecules 1-11 and 13.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Computed from the paper's Table 5 values using the same aggregation as the paper (mean absolute deviation); verified against the paper's reported numbers.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's main quantitative claims; used as monotonic threshold targets.

hidden_assets.purpose: norbornenone (molecule 14) CCSD and B3LYP reference values and tolerance ranges
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table 5 (molecule 14 row) and discussion in Section 3.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values taken from the paper: CCSD = -740.6, B3LYP = -1215.8; tolerance window of ±50 set as per the approved reproduction plan to allow for implementation differences.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the specific paper-reported computed values; a correct reproduction should fall near these numbers.

outputs.description: Computed specific rotations [α]_D for each molecule and method, from which the checker recomputes the average absolute deviations relative to experimental [α]_D values and verifies the relative accuracy ordering.

steps.description: Ensure CSV has exactly 13 rows and required columns are numeric.
Recompute mean absolute deviation for HF over molecules 1-11,13 and score monotonic threshold.
Check CCSD value for norbornenone within tolerance window.
Check B3LYP value for norbornenone within tolerance window.
